referents.why: First person 'me' in 'they will pursue me': the psalm's voice.
First person possessive 'my life' in the psalm's voice.
Implied first person singular subject of the weqatal 'I will dwell'; the psalm's voice.

links.why: The weqatal 'and I will dwell' continues the clause before it; the waw is fused into the weqatal form, so the relation is 'and then'.
